title: How to dance The Charleston from the 1920s

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher demonstrates solo jazz Charleston steps with verbal counting and on-screen text instructions. She breaks down footwork clearly from multiple angles including front, back, and foot-focused closeups.

Demonstration of the Charleston without twists.
Footwork demonstration and breakdown from the back angle.
Demonstrating timing of twists and weight placement.

But modern dancers usually start with the right foot like this
Practice shifting your weight from one foot to the other with the twists
